# Default backend (ASR_BACKEND=sherpa): SenseVoiceSmall int8 via sherpa-onnx.
# ~350 MB RSS, ~1 s model load. Weights live in models/ (git-ignored).
sherpa-onnx>=1.12,<2
numpy>=1.26

# Optional fallback backend (ASR_BACKEND=funasr): fp32 SenseVoiceSmall via
# funasr/torch. ~1.9 GiB RSS, ~30-60 s load. Only needed if the int8 backend
# is disabled; installs torch, so leave it out of minimal deployments.
funasr>=1.2.6,<2

fastapi>=0.115,<1
uvicorn[standard]>=0.34,<1
python-multipart>=0.0.20,<1
requests>=2.32,<3
